name: awin-mcp
description: Awin (ads): me, list_accounts, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_awin_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWIN_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_awin_api_token.description: Personal Awin API token (https://ui.awin.com/awin-api > 'Show my API token'), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It is user-level: it reaches every advertiser account the user has at least viewer access to. Advertiser API access requires an Accelerate or Advanced plan.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /accounts: the user behind the token and the publisher/advertiser accounts it can access.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /accounts?type=advertiser: advertiser programmes the token's user can access (accountId, accountName = programme name, accountType, userRole). `id` is the advertiserId the report takes as account_id. No currency on this record.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /advertisers/{advertiserId}/reports/publisher?startDate&endDate&timezone=UTC&dateType=transaction: impressions, clicks and transactions per publisher over the window (publishers without activity are omitted). `spend` is totalComm (commission of approved + pending + bonus transactions; the Awin override is not included); pending/confirmed/declined splits are in raw. Awin has no campaigns, so `campaign_id` is not applied.
